title: very cute, lots of stuff
text: I thought this was adorable... I bought one for myself because I love Pusheen, and lots of cute stuff, but it was a mix of stuff for adults and kids, and I don't have kids, so I won't get another.  For instance, my box came with a can cozy, but also a blow up pool raft.  All in all, very cute, and if you and your kid both like Pusheen, you'll get a lot of use out of this box!
label: positive
